blocs.x: RELL Seas features a complex and detailed combat system with unique mechanics.
blocs.f: RELL Seas propose un système de combat riche et détaillé, avec des mécaniques uniques.

lignes.x: Commonly referred to as M1s (Mouse Button 1) attacks can be performed up to 5 times dealing damage to players who do not block, switch or evade the attack. After 5 attacks, the player will knock the opponent away. While attacking, the player can alter their attack into an uppercut as long as it is before the final M1. Attack speed can change based on the weapon or fighting style being used.
lignes.f: Les M1 (clic gauche) s'enchaînent jusqu'à 5 fois et touchent les joueurs qui ne bloquent pas, ne font pas de Switch ni d'Evade. Au 5e coup, l'adversaire est projeté. Avant le dernier M1, tu peux transformer l'attaque en uppercut. La vitesse d'attaque dépend de l'arme ou du style de combat.

lignes.x: Commonly referred to as blocking allows the player to block damage from incoming attacks. Blocks can be broken by using a block breaking move, dazing the player. The final M1 is always a block breaker.
lignes.f: Le blocage réduit les dégâts des attaques. Un coup brise-garde le casse et étourdit le joueur. Le dernier M1 brise toujours la garde.

lignes.x: Commonly referred to as Q Spec. The player dashes forwards and attacks the opponent. Your weapon class will change the range of your strong (with heavy being the furthest). If two opponents use strong at the same camera angle, they will enter a clash.
lignes.f: Aussi appelé « Q Spec ». Le joueur fonce et frappe. La classe d'arme change la portée du Strong (Heavy va le plus loin). Si deux adversaires lancent un Strong sous le même angle de caméra, ils entrent en clash.

lignes.x: When the player is in the air, they can perform a down slam by attacking and moving backwards. Down slam will block break.
lignes.f: En l'air, attaque en reculant pour faire un down slam. Le down slam brise la garde.

lignes.x: When X is pressed the player will go out of a combo by gaining I-frames. The evade bar will fill up as you take damage.
lignes.f: Avec X, tu sors d'un combo en gagnant des frames d'invincibilité. La barre d'Evade se remplit quand tu subis des dégâts.

lignes.x: When the player times his right mouse button before he gets hit by an attack. The player will deflect the incoming attack, and gain a free combo starter. The switch bar will fill up as you deal damage.
lignes.f: Clic droit au bon moment juste avant un coup : tu dévies l'attaque et gagnes un début de combo gratuit. La barre de Switch se remplit quand tu infliges des dégâts.

lignes.x: While attacking, the player can lift the opponent in the air by jumping before their final M1.
lignes.f: En attaquant, saute avant le dernier M1 pour soulever l'adversaire dans les airs.

lignes.x: ... The switch bar will fill up as you deal damage.
lignes.f: … La barre de Switch se remplit quand tu infliges des dégâts.

blocs.x: The Marines are a global faction controlled by the World Government system. They have a strictly structured hierarchy, with ranks based on experience and actions. One of the Marines' primary functions is to control government-controlled areas, hunt pirates, and, most importantly, protect taxpayers in government-controlled urban areas.

lignes.x: A centralized military organization tasked with enforcing order and justice throughout the seas. The Marines operate under a strict hierarchy and are charged with suppressing piracy and protecting allied territories.

Lastly the Zoan class allows the user to transform into an animal species, or a hybrid version.

blocs.x: Hades' Asylum is a giant and high-security prison that was created and controlled by the Marines, for the means to imprison the worst pirates imaginable. Players get sent down to Hades' Asylum if they get captured by a high-ranking Marine, or manage to accumulate a level 3 Prison level. There are 6 levels with different puzzles, mini games, biomes, and a gulag system. Every level is its own instance, meaning that it's on a whole different server from the main servers. High-ranking Marines will be able to operate the elevator and capture players and NPCs. Corrupt Marines will be able to release captured Pirates if they wish.
blocs.f: Hades' Asylum est une immense prison de haute sécurité créée et contrôlée par la Marine pour y enfermer les pires pirates. Chaque niveau est une instance séparée, sur un autre serveur que le monde principal. Les Marines haut gradés peuvent manœuvrer l'ascenseur et capturer joueurs et PNJ ; les Marines corrompus peuvent libérer des pirates s'ils le veulent.

blocs.x: In Rell seas, one of the main non linear ways to progress is by doing events, which are random encounters that give you XP, items, money, and possibly even more. Events can have multiple sides, an event can spawn with one of the 40 ingame factions, who you choose to help effects your reputation with the factions in a positive and negative way. If more than two random encounters play, it will start a bigger battle.
blocs.f: Les événements sont un moyen majeur de progresser : des rencontres aléatoires qui rapportent XP, objets, argent, voire plus. Un événement peut impliquer une des 40 factions du jeu ; aider l'une ou l'autre change ta réputation auprès d'elles, en bien ou en mal. Si plus de deux rencontres se déclenchent, elles tournent à la grande bataille.

blocs.x: There will be two kinds of crews in RELL Seas which players will be able to interact with, and one kind which is a bit more difficult. The two interactive crews are the player crews and the NPC crews respectively. The player crews are rather straightforward: one player creates a crew and a Jolly Roger, and other players join that crew. NPC crews, on the other hand, will be slightly more interesting. They will be local to a player's ship, meaning (from what I understand) they cannot leave said ship. However, this also means that they will have functions on that ship that make it operate better or faster. The third kind of crew is one that player technically can interact with. This third kind of crew is the event or faction crew. These crews spawn in from the revealed world events, of which there will be over forty. Since so little about this third kind of crew has been revealed, it is hard to give accurate information about them other than the fact that they will be in game.
blocs.f: Il y aura deux types d'équipages avec qui interagir : les équipages de joueurs et les équipages PNJ. Équipage de joueurs : un joueur crée l'équipage et son Jolly Roger, les autres le rejoignent. Équipages PNJ : ils restent attachés à ton navire, mais y remplissent des fonctions qui le font tourner mieux ou plus vite.

blocs.x: Another unique feature of RELL Seas is its confirmed ship management mechanics. In-game, you will be able to interact with NPCs and by some method or another (yet unrevealed) get them to join your crew. This, in addition to the game's amazing ship mechanics, will create a fun and engaging experience for players as they learn to work with the NPCs to create efficient vessels. More details will be added to this section once more data is available, but the outlook for NPC Crews is very good so far.
blocs.f: Autre particularité confirmée de RELL Seas : la gestion du navire. En jeu, tu pourras parler à des PNJ et, d'une façon encore non dévoilée, les faire rejoindre ton équipage. Avec les mécaniques de navire, il faudra apprendre à travailler avec eux pour faire tourner un bateau efficace.

blocs.x: Open World is the main gamemode in RELL Seas, featuring both PvE (Player versus Environment) and PvP (Player versus Player) gameplay in a large world composed of multiple islands and seas. Players explore freely using ships, complete variou quests that provide experience, currencies, and Equipment, and engage in combat with various Enemies and Bosses that drop rare loot. The mode additionally includes faction systems where players can align with groups such as Pirates or Marines, affecting quests and PvP interactions. PvP combat is enabled in most areas, allowing for player battles on land and at sea, with ships playing a crucial role in travel and naval combat. Additionally, the world features dynamic events, treasure hunts, and hidden collectibles, encouraging exploration and competition.
blocs.f: Le monde ouvert est le mode principal de RELL Seas : JcE et JcJ dans un grand monde fait de nombreuses îles et mers. On explore librement en navire, on fait des quêtes qui rapportent XP, monnaie et équipement, et on affronte ennemis et boss qui lâchent des butins rares. Des systèmes de factions permettent de rejoindre les Pirates ou la Marine, ce qui change les quêtes et le JcJ. Le JcJ est actif dans la plupart des zones, sur terre comme en mer ; les navires sont essentiels pour voyager et combattre.

blocs.x: Leveling up your talents in RELL Seas is one of the main ways that you will progress in the game. You can do whatever you please to progress, from navigating, repairing, fishing, cooking and more. Crews will need players dedicated to 1 or more talents to enhance the experience. Talents will use a ranking system from "F" being the lowest, and "A" being the highest. Also depending on the grade of your talents, it may influence certain actions in the game and your reputation. You might want to be careful though, as you may even get persecuted by the Marines.

blocs.x: You can upgrade your weapon about 20 times to make it better for combat usage. Stronger weapons have fewer upgrades, and weaker weapons have more. This means that every weapon could be viable for combat, even the early game ones. The materials for the upgrades are randomly generated, so you'll have to explore the game to upgrade your weapon to its full potential.
blocs.f: Une arme s'améliore environ 20 fois. Les armes fortes ont moins de paliers, les faibles en ont plus : toutes peuvent rester viables, même celles du début. Les matériaux demandés sont tirés au hasard, il faut donc explorer pour amener ton arme à son plein potentiel.

blocs.x: The Venom Fruit is a Paramecia type God Fruit that grants the user the ability to produce and control different types of poison, as well as grants immunity to all forms of poison, making the user a Poison Human This ability is not to be confused with a Logia type power, as the user cannot transform their body into poison.
blocs.f: Venom est un Fruit du démon de type Paramecia qui permet de produire et contrôler différents poisons, avec une immunité à tous les poisons. Ce n'est pas un Logia : l'utilisateur ne peut pas transformer son corps en poison.

blocs.x: In RELL Seas, weapons play a central role in combat and progression. Each weapon features a unique model and set of abilities.
blocs.f: Les armes sont au cœur du combat et de la progression. Chacune a son modèle et ses capacités.

blocs.x: Weapons are categorised into 4 different classes: Light, Medium, Heavy, and Ranged. Each class affects gameplay characteristics such as attack speed, range, and damage output. During the Character Customisation screen players can select a weapon class to bond with. In addition, your selected weapon class provides a bonus to Weapon EXP gain in the same class.
blocs.f: Les armes se répartissent en 4 classes : Light, Medium, Heavy et Ranged. La classe change la vitesse d'attaque, la portée et les dégâts. À la création du personnage, tu choisis une classe d'arme de prédilection : elle donne un bonus d'XP d'arme dans cette classe.

lignes.x: Light weapons are characterised by a high attack speed and small physical size. The damage per individual strike is generally lower than that of heavier weapon classes (UNCONFIRMED) and the Q Spec range is also less.
lignes.f: Les armes Light ont une grande vitesse d'attaque et une petite taille. Leurs dégâts par coup sont en général plus faibles que les classes plus lourdes (non confirmé), et leur Q Spec porte moins loin.

lignes.x: Medium weapons are characterised by a moderate attack speed and medium physical size. They offer a balance between the damage of heavy weapons and the speed of light weapons (UNCONFIRMED) and the Q Spec range is moderate.
lignes.f: Les armes Medium ont une vitesse d'attaque et une taille moyennes : un équilibre entre les dégâts des Heavy et la vitesse des Light (non confirmé). Portée du Q Spec : moyenne.

lignes.x: Heavy weapons are characterised by a low attack speed and large physical size. The damage per individual strike is generally the highest among melee classes (UNCONFIRMED) and the Q Spec often has a higher range.
lignes.f: Les armes Heavy ont une faible vitesse d'attaque et une grande taille. Leurs dégâts par coup sont en général les plus élevés des armes de mêlée (non confirmé), et leur Q Spec a souvent plus de portée.

lignes.x: Ranged weapons are characterised by their ability to attack from a distance using limited ammo and often feature a unique ranged Q Spec. They function similarly to other weapon classes, with M1 speed.
lignes.f: Les armes à distance attaquent de loin avec des munitions limitées, souvent avec un Q Spec à distance unique. Pour le reste, elles fonctionnent comme les autres classes, avec la vitesse de M1.

blocs.x: Upgrading weapons is done through Blacksmith NPCs found on various islands. Each upgrade requires specific amounts of different materials, which are randomised after each upgrade. Weapons can be upgraded up to 20 times, with each upgrade increasing damage scaling (unconfirmed).
blocs.f: Les armes s'améliorent chez les forgerons PNJ de différentes îles. Chaque amélioration demande des quantités précises de matériaux, tirées au hasard après chaque palier. Jusqu'à 20 améliorations, chacune augmentant la progression des dégâts (non confirmé).

blocs.x: Enchanting weapons is also done through Blacksmith NPCs. Giving the weapon a unique passive ability based on the element enchantment (unconfirmed but likely).
blocs.f: L'enchantement des armes se fait aussi chez les forgerons PNJ. Il donne à l'arme un passif unique selon l'élément (non confirmé, mais probable).

blocs.x: In RELL Seas, the Weather shifts randomly around the game, which visually affects the environment and objects around them, as well as NPCs doing certain actions when the environment changes.
blocs.f: La météo change au hasard dans le jeu : elle modifie l'environnement et les objets, et les PNJ réagissent aux changements.

lignes.x: A Light Storm is a mild type of thunderstorm that produces some lightning strikes and rain. If the player stays in this weather for too long, their clothes or armor may start to soak and become wet (it is unknown as to whether this may provide any status effects).
lignes.f: La Light Storm est un orage léger : quelques éclairs et de la pluie. Si tu restes trop longtemps dessous, tes vêtements ou ton armure peuvent se mouiller (on ne sait pas encore si ça donne un effet de statut).

items.x: When a light storm starts, NPCs head indoors/take shelter. It is only stationary NPCs that don't take shelter (e.g., Marine Guards on Protection)
items.f: Quand une Light Storm commence, les PNJ rentrent s'abriter. Seuls les PNJ fixes restent dehors (ex. : gardes de la Marine en faction).

blocs.x: Ship materials are a must-have; their primary purpose is to give the ship's hull a different texture or (potentially) greater durability. Materials are a ship customization option and can be obtained through crafting.
blocs.f: Les matériaux de navire sont indispensables : ils changent la texture de la coque et peut-être sa solidité. Ils font partie de la personnalisation et s'obtiennent par l'artisanat.

blocs.x: Yahu is a terrifying aquatic boss rumored to be older than the sea itself. Its enormous body can coil around islands, and it's capable of summoning tidal waves with a flick of its tail. Long-range attacks and mobility are essential when facing this monstrosity.
blocs.f: Yahu est un boss aquatique terrifiant, qu'on dit plus vieux que la mer elle-même. Son corps immense peut s'enrouler autour d'îles, et un coup de queue suffit à déclencher des raz-de-marée. Attaques à longue portée et mobilité sont indispensables face à ce monstre.
